## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
$env:NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '1'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git status --short
```

Pass means frozen install exits `0`; CI exits `0` with all unit, determinism, import-boundary, nondeterministic-API, and artifact checks; the final suite reports 4 test files and 41 tests passing; governance reports 7 passing tests; and `git diff --check` exits `0`.
